svg.title: Individual quantum detections build a two-slit interference pattern
svg.desc: A schematic coherent source illuminates two slits. Wavefronts represent indistinguishable alternatives, not individual particle trajectories. Many localized detector dots accumulate in bright and dark bands on a screen when no which-path information is available. The bands are an illustrative probability pattern, not measured experimental data.
svg.text: One event. A pattern over time.
Schematic · coherent light · no which-path information
